import asyncio
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
ACTIONS = ("interrupt", "discard", "enqueue")

RULE = "只判最新一句。结合历史和现场。回答当前提问要留，引用、否定、稍后停止不打断。"
OPTIONS = (
    "正在播报或执行，用户要求立刻停止、纠正或换事。",
    "无需回应的附和、闲聊或对他人说话。",
    "保留回答、请求、补充和不明确的输入。",
)
WINDOWS = (2, 4, 8, 10)

def compact(row, count):
    info = row["input"]
    state = info["live_state"]
    fields = ("播报", "执行", "等待回答")
    flags = " ".join(f"{label}={('未知' if value is None else '是' if value else '否')}" for label, value in zip(fields, state.values()))
    lines = [flags, "历史："]
    for entry in info["prior_dialogue"][-count:] if count else []:
        role = "用户" if entry["role"] == "user" else "助手"
        lines.append(role + "：" + json.dumps(entry["text"], ensure_ascii=False))
    lines.append("最新用户转写：" + json.dumps(info["latest_user_transcript"], ensure_ascii=False))
    return "\n".join(lines)

def tokenizer_path(base, tag):
    root = Path(base["model"]).parent
    if tag == "q08":
        return root.parent / "gpu-pipelined-b2" / "qwen3_5_0_8b_decode_int8hu_block32_sym" / "tokenizer"
    return root / "tokenizer"

def llm(tag, rows):
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    base = json.loads(Path(f"/tmp/mh-duplex-{tag}-input.json").read_text())
    t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(Path(base["model"]).parent / "tokenizer", local_files_only=True)
    labels = "123"
    candidates = [t.encode(label, add_special_tokens=False) for label in labels]
    assert all(len(x) == 1 for x in candidates)
    formatted = []
    for row in rows:
        start = time.perf_counter()
        content = RULE + "\n" + "\n".join(f"{label} {opt}" for label, opt in zip(labels, OPTIONS))
        content += "\n只回答 1、2 或 3。\n" + row["compact"]
        text = t.apply_chat_template([{"role":"user","content":content}], tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False)
        ids = t.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
        elapsed = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
        assert all(t.encode(text + label, add_special_tokens=False) == ids + token for label, token in zip(labels, candidates))
        formatted.append(dict(id=row["id"],suite=row["suite"],ids=ids,tokenizationMS=elapsed))
    base.update(cases=formatted,candidateIDs=[x[0] for x in candidates])
    return base

async def d3(rows):
    sys.path.insert(0, "/Users/devil/Pro/d3-edge-coreai/bundle")
    from coreai_d3 import D3CoreAI, pack
    from coreai.runtime import NDArray
    from d3_format import render
    from d3_runtime import normalize_question
    model = await D3CoreAI.load("/Users/devil/Pro/d3-edge-coreai/bundle")
    question = normalize_question(dict(type="choice",instructions=RULE,criteria=dict(zip(ACTIONS,OPTIONS))))
    for idx,row in enumerate(rows[:3] + rows):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        text = render(model.tokenizer,row["compact"],question.rendered,model.config["codes"])
        encoded = model.tokenizer([text],add_special_tokens=False,return_tensors="np")
        size = encoded["input_ids"].shape[1]
        scores = None
        if size <= 512:
            output = await model.fn({key:NDArray(value) for key,value in pack(encoded,model.manifest).items()})
            scores = output[model.manifest["output"]].numpy()[0,:3].tolist()
        if idx >= 3:
            print(json.dumps(dict(id=row["id"],suite=row["suite"],tokenCount=size,scores=scores,
                inferenceMS=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000 if scores is not None else None,tokenizationMS=0)),flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    base = json.loads(Path("/tmp/mh-duplex-h2-cases.json").read_text())
    source = [row for row in base["cases"] if row["suite"] == "history-20"]
    rows = [
        dict(id=row["id"],expected=row["expected"],suite=f"history-{count}",compact=compact(row,count))
        for count in WINDOWS for row in source
    ]
    tag = sys.argv[1]
    if tag == "cases":
        print(json.dumps(dict(rule=RULE,options=dict(zip(ACTIONS,OPTIONS)),cases=rows),ensure_ascii=False))
    elif tag == "d3":
        asyncio.run(d3([row for row in rows if row["suite"] == "history-8"]))
    else:
        selected = rows if tag == "q05" else [row for row in rows if row["suite"] == "history-8"]
        print(json.dumps(llm(tag,selected),ensure_ascii=False))

def snapshot(tag):
    meta = json.loads(Path(f"/tmp/mh-window-{tag}-meta.json").read_text())
    root = Path.home() / ".cache/huggingface/hub" / ("models--" + meta["id"].replace("/", "--")) / "snapshots" / meta["sha"]
    relative = next(s["rfilename"] for s in meta["siblings"] if s["rfilename"].endswith("main.mlirb") and not any(x in s["rfilename"] for x in ("vision", "s1024")))
    model = (root / relative).parent
    return root, model

async def d3_choice(root, asset, dataset):
    sys.path.insert(0, "/Users/devil/Pro/d3-edge-coreai/bundle")
    from coreai_d3 import pack
    from d3_format import render
    from d3_runtime import normalize_question

    manifest = json.loads((root / "manifest.json").read_text())
    config = json.loads((root / "decision_config.json").read_text())
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(root, local_files_only=True)
    question = normalize_question(dict(type="choice", instructions=dataset["rule"], criteria=dataset["options"]))
    model = await AIModel.load(asset, SpecializationOptions.default())
    fn = model.load_function("main")
    capacity = manifest["sequence_length"]
    visual = NDArray(np.zeros((1, capacity, manifest["hidden_size"]), dtype=np.float32))
    visual_mask = NDArray(np.zeros((1, capacity, 1), dtype=np.bool_))
    async def decision(row):
        text = render(tokenizer, row["compact"], question.rendered, config["codes"])
        encoded = tokenizer([text], add_special_tokens=False, return_tensors="np")
        arrays = {key: NDArray(value) for key, value in pack(encoded, manifest).items()}
        arrays.update(visual_embeddings=visual, visual_mask=visual_mask)
        out = await fn(arrays)
        return encoded["input_ids"].shape[1], capacity, out[manifest["output"]].numpy()[0, :3].tolist()
    return decision

async def bert(tag, root, asset, dataset):
    is_laya = tag == "laya"
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained((root if is_laya else asset.parent) / "tokenizer", local_files_only=True)
    assert (tokenizer.cls_token_id, tokenizer.sep_token_id, tokenizer.mask_token_id, tokenizer.pad_token_id) == (2, 1, 4, 0)
    model = await AIModel.load(asset, SpecializationOptions.from_preferred_compute_unit_kind(ComputeUnitKind.gpu()))
    fns = {}
    async def decision(row):
        def encode(text):
            return tokenizer.encode(text.replace(tokenizer.mask_token, " "), add_special_tokens=False)
        ids = [2, *encode("choice question: " + dataset["rule"]), 1]
        markers = []
        for action, description in dataset["options"].items():
            option = f"{action}: {description}" if is_laya else description
            tokens = encode(" " + option)
            assert len(tokens) <= 48
            markers.append(len(ids))
            ids.extend([4, *tokens])
        ids.append(1)
        assert len(ids) <= (192 if is_laya else 256)
        ids.extend([*encode(row["compact"]), 1])
        n = len(ids)
        capacity = next(cap for cap in ((96, 256, 512, 1024) if is_laya else (512,)) if n <= cap)
        key = f"L{capacity}" if is_laya else "main"
        if key not in fns:
            fns[key] = model.load_function(key)
        values = {
            "input_ids": np.array([ids + [0] * (capacity - n)], np.int32),
            "attention_mask": np.array([[1] * n + [0] * (capacity - n)], np.int32),
        }
        if is_laya:
            values.update(
                marker_pos=np.array([markers + [0] * (32 - len(markers))], np.int32),
                marker_mask=np.array([[1] * len(markers) + [0] * (32 - len(markers))], np.int32),
                qtype=np.array([0], np.int32),
            )
        else:
            values["qtype_onehot"] = np.array([[1, 0, 0]], np.float32)
        output = await fns[key]({name: NDArray(value) for name, value in values.items()})
        scores = output["logits"].numpy()[0,:3] if is_laya else output["token_logits"].numpy()[0,markers]
        return n, capacity, scores.tolist()
    return decision

async def main(tag):
    root, asset = snapshot(tag)
    dataset = json.loads(Path("/tmp/mh-window-cases.json").read_text())
    assert tuple(dataset["options"]) == ACTION_IDS
    start = time.perf_counter()
    decision = await (d3_choice(root, asset, dataset) if tag in ("lite", "nano") else bert(tag, root, asset, dataset))
    print(json.dumps({"loadMS": (time.perf_counter()-start)*1000}), flush=True)
    window = None
    rejected = False
    for row in dataset["cases"]:
        if row["suite"] != window:
            window, rejected = row["suite"], False
            for _ in range(3):
                await decision(row)
        if rejected:
            continue
        start = time.perf_counter()
        token_count, capacity, scores = await decision(row)
        elapsed = (time.perf_counter()-start)*1000
        assert len(scores) == 3 and all(math.isfinite(v) for v in scores)
        print(json.dumps({
            "id": row["id"], "suite": window, "scores": scores, "tokenCount": token_count,
            "window_tokens": capacity, "inferenceMS": elapsed, "tokenizationMS": 0,
        }), flush=True)
        rejected = elapsed > 100

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main(sys.argv[1]))
